note: 仅导出归属本人的已审阅字段；运行队列、凭据及其他用户资料不纳入导出。

datasets.name: attempts
datasets.select: SELECT id,paper_id,lesson_id,status,score,passed,created_at,submitted_at,graded_at FROM exam_attempt WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_attempt WHERE user_id=?

datasets.name: answers
datasets.select: SELECT a.attempt_id,a.question_id,a.response,a.score,a.feedback FROM exam_answer a JOIN exam_attempt t ON t.id=a.attempt_id WHERE t.user_id=? ORDER BY a.attempt_id,a.question_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_answer a JOIN exam_attempt t ON t.id=a.attempt_id WHERE t.user_id=?

datasets.name: drafts
datasets.select: SELECT d.attempt_id,d.answers,d.version,d.updated_at FROM exam_draft d JOIN exam_attempt t ON t.id=d.attempt_id WHERE t.user_id=? ORDER BY d.attempt_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_draft d JOIN exam_attempt t ON t.id=d.attempt_id WHERE t.user_id=?

datasets.name: operations
datasets.select: SELECT operation_id,kind,status,error_code,created_at,updated_at FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at,operation_id
datasets.count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reliability_operation WHERE user_id=?
